[#90DBFF[]]Vanilla Expansion原版扩展[white[]]的开发者工具扩展包
developer tools add-on for the [#90DBFF[]]Vanilla Expansion[white[]] (VE)

[red[]]需先启用 Vanilla Expansion 模组。
Requires Vanilla Expansion to be enabled.[white[]]

本模组主要收录 VE 战役地图中与剧情相关的世界处理器组及世界处理器蓝图，供社区地图作者与附属模组开发者参考、复用和二次创作。
This addon mainly collects world processor groups and world processor schematics related to the VE campaign storyline, providing community map authors and addon developers with references for reuse and further creation.

感谢所有为本模组贡献并参与测试的成员！
Thank you to everyone who contributed and helped test this addon!
